hook_line: CHIPS BOUNCE AFTER WORST SELLOFF SINCE 2020
diaspora_bullets: Friday's gains recovered only part of Thursday's losses
Analysts called it a reflex bounce, not a resolution
news_summary: Chip stocks rebounded on Friday after the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12.25% on November 5, its biggest one-day drop since March 2020.
payoff: Friday's rebound recovered only part of Thursday's losses.
